title: Member Tenure Reductions on Returned Later Nights of Free Night Awards
content:
The tenure reduction applies to the protected rebooking price stated on the return record of one of the Free Night Awards returned from a later night of a reservation cancelled after its deadline. It turns on the member's enrolment date in Ashbury Rewards.

**Schedule.** The tenure reduction is the long-tenure reduction for a member enrolled at least the long-tenure months before the return, the mid-tenure reduction for one enrolled at least the mid-tenure months before it, and nothing otherwise, the months being whole calendar months from the enrolment date to the date of the return.

| Whole calendar months from enrolment date to the date of the return | Tenure reduction |
|---|---|
| At least 120 months (long-tenure months) | 2000 points (long-tenure reduction) |
| At least 60 months but fewer than 120 | 1000 points (mid-tenure reduction) |
| Fewer than 60 months | No tenure reduction |

The tenure reduction is taken off the protected rebooking price once. The enrolment date is the one on the member's Ashbury Rewards membership record.

### Boundary pairs (hypothetical return dated 20 September)

| Enrolment date | Whole months to the return | Reduction |
|---|---|---|
| 20 September, ten years earlier | 120 | 2000 |
| 21 September, ten years earlier | 119 | 1000 |
| 20 September, five years earlier | 60 | 1000 |
| 21 September, five years earlier | 59 | None |
